title: Avatar: The Last Airbender Co-Creator Addresses Next Major Series Release Date
content: Avatar: Seven Havens is currently taking up all of the attention right now, but the co-creator behind the franchise has addressed when fans might be able to see the next major series coming in the Avatar Studios pipeline. And it’s going to take a lot longer than what fans might think.
author: ComicBook

title: Exclusive: Nakama Press Licenses Uoyama's Opening the Door to Hinata-San's Heart Manga
content: Nakama Press revealed to ANN on Tuesday that it has licensed Uoyama 's Opening the Door to Hinata-san's Heart ( Hinata-san, Hoshino Desu ) manga for print release. The company has also revealed the upcoming volume 1 cover and several pages from the first volume: Nakama Press will release the first volume on February…
author: ANN

title: Mission: Yozakura Family's Hitsuji Gondaira Launches Manga About Police Officer in Meiji-Era Japan
content: This year's 51st issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine announced on Monday that Hitsuji Gondaira will launch a new series titled Ginza Uradoori Kо̄ban no HIzuki-san (Officer Hizuki of a Police Box on a Back Street in Ginza) in the next issue on November 24.
author: ANN

title: Trinity Blood Artist Kiyo Kyujyō Launches Manga About Leonardo da Vinci
content: Manga creator Kiyo Kyujyō (sometimes credited as Kiyo Qjo ) launched a new manga titled Davide no Ishi (David's Stone) in Kadokawa 's KadoComi website on Monday. The manga is set in 15th century Florence, a city swirling with the air of desire, ambition, and jealousy in the midst of the Renaissance.
author: ANN

title: Additional Cast for 'Odoru Sennen Kazoku' Announced
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Akira Kazugai 's Odoru Sennen Kazoku ( Millennium Family ) manga announced six additional cast members on Sunday. The anime series will air on TBS and other channels.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Mistress Kanan Is Devilishly Easy Season 2 Anime Reveals Visual, Trailer, Additional Cast
content: The previously announced Mistress Kanan Is Devilishly Easy Season 2, now titled Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy 2 EASY revealed a new visual, trailer, and four additional voice cast. The sequel is set to premiere in 2027.
author: Anime Corner

title: Witch Watch Manga Ends With Anime Season 2 to Air in 2027
content: Kenta Shinohara 's Witch Watch manga ended in this year's 51st issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine on Monday. The staff of the television anime adaptation also unveiled its second season's teaser visual and 2027 premiere window. Viz Media and MANGA Plus are both publishing Witch Watch in English.
author: ANN

title: 'Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, New Staff, First Promo, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of nonco 's Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi ( Mistress Kanan is Devilishly Easy ) manga revealed additional cast, new staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and the first promotional video for the second season , subtitled Easy , on Tuesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Josemaru Short Anime's 3rd Teaser Reveals More Cast, January 10 Debut
content: The staff for the television short anime of creator Inochi-ya's Josemaru character revealed on Tuesday the anime's third teaser promotional video, key visual, three additional cast members, and January 10 premiere. In the video, the title character J osemaru introduces the cast of characters.
author: ANN
